title: The global trial includes every structural, target and soft-source term
statement: For the actual M_s indicator trial, area-resolved positive nonbacktracking walk counts acquire a complete tuple overcount of up to eight affected domains. Paid long-perimeter tail, majority crossings and original source-target overlap remain in W/ZA. It does not restrict support to Ferrers shapes. The direct area DP has polynomial but steep O(M^6) arithmetic/O(M^5) storage bounds, including integer precision; a global upper alone does not certify near-optimal W/C or an efficient energy-edge sampler.
